read.thesis: Hilton is a capital-light franchisor: 6.7% net unit growth and 520,000-room pipeline with conversions near 40%, but 2026 RevPAR guided only 1%–2% with US RevPAR soft.

triggers.label: Q1 2026 RevPAR guided ~12%
triggers.quote: For the first quarter, we expect RevPAR growth of between 12% year over year, including the impact from the recent storms in the U.S.
triggers.highlight: we expect RevPAR growth of between 12%

triggers.label: Global construction starts up 20%+ in 2026
triggers.quote: Globally, for 2026, we expect new development construction starts to be up over 20%, bringing us back close to 2019 levels
triggers.highlight: new development construction starts to be up over 20%

triggers.label: FY26 RevPAR 1%–2%
triggers.quote: For the full year, we expect system-wide top-line growth of 1% to 2%, with international performance stronger than in the U.S.
